title: Gap kind: prerequisite met but not recorded
goal: Each done prerequisite of another repository missing from externalMet is proposed, whatever the state of the step's other prerequisites
acceptance: New kind "Prerequisite met but not recorded" per prerequisite: <repo>: record <dep> in externalMet on <step>
The existing "Waits on work that is done" still fires when every prerequisite is done
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first: a step with one of two external prerequisites done and unrecorded produces one gap
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories and manifests; no personal data.
escalation: A change to how existing gap kinds behave goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one gap kind over the existing prerequisite reader and fixtures. Not a measurement.
